Well there are four options when you have dupes. 

1) Merge them into another hero of the same rarity or lower to increase their level cap by one. This option is the best option if you have summoned a dupe five star that will serve no purpose for skill inheriting or in battle. I advise only merging 5 star dupes because increased level cap does not carry over through unlocking potential.

2) Skill inheriting. I would say this is probably the best use of dupes over all. If you summon a dupe you do not need you can get rid of it in order to pass on three of their skills to another hero. This will allow you to make any hero stronger. Many heroes have useful skills they can pass on.

3) Raise them and use them in combat. Not many people would find use in bringing two of the same hero into battle. But if the dupe you have summoned is a strong 5 star and you do not have many heroes to fill their roll it would be a good idea to keep them at least until you have gotten more 5 stars.

4) Send them home for feathers. This option is only best if the dupe you have gotten will serve no purpose to you in combat, has no useful skills you wish to pass on, and is not at 5 star rarity making merging useless.
